appraisal_events.evidence: il se souciait seulement de celui qu'ils feraient sur moi... un changement de décor comparable à celui qui introduit tout à coup Parsifal au milieu des filles fleurs
appraisal_events.explanation: The duc's unusual deference toward the narrator, and the salon's admiring, sensuous reception, mark the narrator's admission into elite society as a clear ascent from his ordinary treatment as a child.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle désirait...témoigner au prochain...qu'elle ne le méprisait pas; ...expulser toute huile essentielle de violettes et tout parfum stendhalien du nom de la princesse et à y incorporer à la place l'image d'une petite femme noire...fait moins penser à la Chartreuse où meurt Fabrice qu'à la salle des pas perdus de la gare Saint-Lazare
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's own retrospective analysis strips the princess's flattering warmth of personal significance, exposing it as generic aristocratic condescension, and replaces the romantic expectation attached to her name with a banal, deflating reality.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator is drawn into the elite, admiring world of the Guermantes salon and treated with unaccustomed courtesy and deference.
Her seemingly personal warmth is revealed as impersonal noblesse-oblige performance, and her real presence deflates the poetic expectation carried by her name.

ambiguities: The duc de Guermantes's warmth toward the narrator is explicitly described as partly performative ('en partie factice et dictée par la politesse') and partly sincere, so the endorsement of the elevation in E1 is qualified rather than absolute.
